function nested<T extends string>(t: T): `(${T})` {
  return `(${`${t}`})`;
}
function unconstrained<T>(t: T): `<${T & string}>` {
  return `<${t}>`;
}
function numeric<T extends number>(t: T): `${T}` {
  const text = `${t}`;
  return text;
}
function other<T extends string>(t: T): "x" {
  return `<${t}>`;
}
const point = { x: 1 };
const shown: `p${number}` = `p${point}`;
console.log(nested, unconstrained, numeric, other, shown);
